name: ghost
description: Ghost — a local-first MCP memory server for Claude Code. One binary, one SQLite file, no cloud.

plugins.name: ghost
plugins.description: MCP memory server for Claude Code on macOS and Linux (including WSL): project context injection, memory save/search, and automatic consolidation. Bundles every macOS and Linux binary behind one zero-config launcher. On native Windows install ghost-windows-amd64 or ghost-windows-arm64 instead.

plugins.name: ghost-windows-amd64
plugins.description: MCP memory server for Claude Code on 64-bit native Windows (x64/amd64) — the architecture of most Windows PCs. Bundles a native ghost.exe for the MCP server and both lifecycle hooks; zero configuration.

plugins.name: ghost-windows-arm64
plugins.description: MCP memory server for Claude Code on Windows on ARM (ARM64) — Snapdragon X / Surface-class PCs. Bundles a native ghost.exe for the MCP server and both lifecycle hooks; zero configuration.
